name: Motion Sensor II
description: A wireless, battery-powered motion sensor that can turn Insteon-controlled lights on when someone enters a room and off after they leave.

steps.text: Remove the battery tab to power the Motion Sensor.
Place it on a tabletop with the flat battery cover on, mount it in a corner with the two adhesive strips, or slide off the flat back and screw the flexible mount bracket to a solid surface.

notes: It runs on a CR123A battery (6 to 18 months, depending on use) or on a right-angled Micro USB cable 2822-222 and a USB power adapter.
Clean the wall before using the adhesive strips; the sensor must be unmounted to replace the battery.
Installing the sensitivity jumper across both pins reduces the range by about 10 feet (from 30 feet).

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the LED blinks green.

notes: The first device put into linking mode becomes the controller and the second the responder. Linking mode ends after a link is made or after four minutes without one.

To control a device: turn it on to the level you want, then press and hold its SET button until it double-beeps (for Insteon bulbs, remove power and restore it). Test by tapping the Motion Sensor's SET button to simulate motion.
To add it to a Hub, when the app prompts, press and hold the SET button until it beeps, then tap the SET button.
Don't use local programming if a Hub or other central controller manages the sensor.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the LED blinks green.
Adjust each device to its scene state and, one at a time, press and hold its SET button until it double-beeps.
Tap the SET button to leave multi-link mode.

notes: Multi-link mode lasts four minutes, restarting after each successful link.

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the LED blinks green.
Press and hold the SET button again until the LED blinks red.

notes: Then press and hold the controlled device's SET button until it double-beeps. Unlinking mode ends after one unlink or four minutes.

For several devices, tap the SET button after the LED blinks red (it double-blinks red), press and hold each device's SET button until it double-beeps, then tap the SET button to leave multi-unlink mode.

steps.text: Slide off the battery cover and remove the battery.
Press and hold the SET button while reinstalling the battery.
Keep holding the SET button until the Motion Sensor stops beeping.
steps.expect: Double beep when the reset is complete

notes: Erases all links and customized properties.
Groups other than 1 are off by default.
Its heartbeat's cmd1, 0x11 to 0x14, gives the battery level from fully charged to almost empty.
Optional groups report temperature and light levels.

Groups 5, 6, 9 and 10 report the end of motion, dawn, heat and cold as an on instead of an off to groups 1, 2, 7 and 8; the Motion Sensor III sends to them only when they have links. Groups 7 to 10 are the Motion Sensor III's.
Its heartbeat is about once a day, plus or minus 10 percent.
sources: Motion Sensor II 2844 Quick Start Guide
